deviations.what: the sap.f.HeroBanner control is newer than 1.71 (sap/f/HeroBanner.js: @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 - an EXPERIMENTAL wrapper around the UI5 Web Components fiori HeroBanner, extending sap.ui.core.webc.WebComponent) and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.152. HeroBanner members used: the actions, startContent and endContent aggregations and columnsRatio (sap.f.HeroBannerColumnsRatio FirstWider) - all @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 with the control.

The two sap.ui.integration widgets Card controls keep their manifest as a literal URL, as in the original, but absolutized: the original's relative test-resources/sap/f/demokit/sample/HeroBannerIntegrationCard/startContentManifest.json and endContentManifest.json have no document root to resolve against in an abap2UI5 app, so the port points at https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/... (both files verified 2026-10-20: HTTP 200, byte-identical to the archived ui5/sap.f/HeroBannerIntegrationCard copies, served with access-control-allow-origin: *). The Cards therefore load their manifests from the live OpenUI5 demo kit, whose version moves on (1.153.0 on that date); the manifests carry their list data inline (content.data.json), so no further request is needed.

Unverified in a running system: that both Card controls fetch their manifest cross-origin from sdk.openui5.org and render their List content inside the HeroBanner's startContent and endContent slots. The render gate only proves the view creates; it does not wait for the manifest request.
